Banner that says how a saved name mapping was matched

Source: R/wizard-mapping_steps.R
mapping_provenance_banner.Rd

Builds the information banner the two mapping steps show under their status message once a mapping is saved. It says how many of the saved matches were made automatically and how many the user chose, from the mapping's source column ("auto" or "user" per row, written by mapping_modal_server()).

Usage

mapping_provenance_banner(mapping_df, i18n)

Arguments

mapping_df

The saved mapping, a data frame with a source column, or NULL.

i18n

The app's translator (a shiny.i18n translator), used for every label.

Value

The banner as Shiny tags, or NULL when mapping_df is NULL, has no rows or has no source column.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# in a module's server: under the mapping's button, say how the saved names were matched
output$survey_map_summary <- renderUI(mapping_provenance_banner(cache()$survey_mapping, i18n))

# the banner for a mapping of three names, two matched by the dialog and one by the user
mapping <- data.frame(
  admin_level_1 = c("Nairobi", "Mombasa", "Kisumu"),
  adminlevel_1 = c("Nairobi", "Mombasa", "Kisumu"),
  source = c("auto", "auto", "user")
)
mapping_provenance_banner(mapping, i18n)
} # }
